landing.heroHeadline: Snap a Photo. Protect Nature. See Instant Action.
landing.heroSub: Instantly report pollution, illegal logging, and wildlife threats. Our AI verifies your photo, notifies the right authorities in seconds, and tracks the case on a public ledger until it's resolved.
landing.ghostSectionTitle: Report the dangerous ones without exposing who you are.
landing.ghostSectionDesc: When illegal loggers and poachers are watching, Ghost Mode lets you vanish. We enforce military-grade anonymity before your report ever leaves your device.
landing.philippinesDeadliest: The Philippines remains Asia's deadliest country for land and environmental defenders. Total anonymity isn't a luxury—it's a survival requirement.
landing.scoreboardSub: Open case files, tracked from the moment they are filed. Resolution times and non-responses are both on the record.
landing.impactTitle: Every report leaves a mark on the public record.
landing.impactSub: Resolution is not promised in a press release. It is counted here, case by case, where it can be checked.

landing.nodeInputLabel: ການປ້ອນຂອງປະຊາຊົນ
landing.nodeInputDetail: Next.js 16 PWA ພ້ອມການບັນທຶກກ້ອນເພື່ອອອັບລາຍນ. ຂໍ້ມູນເສີມ EXIF ຖືກລຶບອອກທາງຝ່າຍລູກຄ້າກ່ອນສົ່ງເພື່ອຄວາມເປັນສ່ວນຕົວ. SHA-256 checksum ແລະ ເວລາຖືກບັນທຶກທາງຝ່າຍເຊີຟເວີເພື່ອຄວາມສຳຄັນຂອງຫຼັກຖານ.
landing.nodeYoloSub: ການກຳນົດວັດຖຸ
landing.nodeYoloDetail: ຝຶກສອກເປັນພິເສດໃນ 12,000+ ຮູບການລະເມີດສິ່ງແວດລ້ອມຂອງຟີລິບປິນ. ກຳນົດການຖິ້ມທີ່ຜິດກົດໝາຍ, ການປ່າຍນ້ຳ, ການທຳລາຍປ່າ, ແລະ 14 ປະເພດການລະເມີດອື່ນໆດ້ວຍ mAP 94.6%.
landing.nodeNeuroLabel: ເຄື່ອງຈັກ Neuro-Symbolic
landing.nodeNeuroSub: FastAPI + ການໃຫ້เหຕົວ
landing.nodeNeuroDetail: ລວມເອົາຜົນລະບົບປັນຍາປະດິດກັບກົດລະບຽບໂລກິກສັນຍາລັກທີ່ມາຈາກກົດໝາຍສິ່ງແວດລ້ອມຟີລິບປິນ (RA 9003, RA 9275, RA 8749). ປະມານການລະເມີດໄປສູ່ກົດໝາຍ ແລະ ລະດັບໂທດທີ່ຖືກຕ້ອງ.
landing.nodeGraphLabel: ແຜງຄວາມຮູ້
landing.nodeGraphDetail: ຖານຂໍ້ມູນແຜງທີ່ໃຊ້ Gremlin ເຊິ່ງປະມານຄວາມສຳພັນລະຫວ່າງການລະເມີດ, ສະຖານທີ່, ອົງກອນ, ກົດໝາຍ, ແລະ ແບບເວລາ. ອະນຸຍາດໃຫ້ມີການສອບຖາມຫຼາຍກັ້ງເພື່ອການກຳນົດແບບ.
landing.nodeRoutingLabel: ການຈັດສົ່ງໃຫ້ອົງການ
landing.nodeRoutingSub: ການສົ່ງອັດຕະໂນມັດ
landing.nodeRoutingDetail: ເຄື່ອງຈັກການນຳທາງສະຫຼັບສະຫຼາດທີ່ປະມານປະເພດການລະເມີດ ແລະ ອຳນາດການປົກຄອງໄປສູ່ໂຕະລັດທີ່ຖືກຕ້ອງ: DENR-EMB ສຳລັບການປ່ອຍອາຍພິດອຸດສາຫະກຳ, PCG ສຳລັບການລະເມີດຊາຍຝັ່ງ, LGU ສຳລັບການບັງຄັບບັນຊາທ້ອງຖິ່ນ.
landing.nodeBackendDetail: API RESTful ພ້ອມການຈັດການ session, DB ກ່ຽວກັບ, ການຄວບຄຸມການເຂົ້າເຖິງຕາມບົດບາດ. ຈັດການບັນຊາປະຊາຊົນ, ວົງຈັບຊີວິດລາຍງານ, ການປະສານງານອົງກອນ, ແລະ ບັນທຶກຄວາມໂປ່ງໃສສາທາລະນະ.

faq.support: ການສະໜັບສະໜຸນ
faq.title: ຄຳຖາມທີ່ຖາມເລື້ອຍໆ
faq.subtitle: ທຸກສິ່ງທີ່ທ່ານຕ້ອງຮູ້ກ່ຽວກັບການລາຍງານກັບ LikasLens
faq.qWhatIs: LikasLens ແມ່ນຫຍັງ?
faq.aWhatIs: LikasLens ແມ່ນແພລດຟອມການລາຍງານສິ່ງແວດລ້ອມທີ່ຂັບເຄື່ອນດ້ວຍ AI. ມັນຊ່ວຍປະຊາຊົນຖ່າຍຮູບໄພອັນຕະລາຍຕໍ່ສິ່ງແວດລ້ອມ, ວິເຄາະດ້ວຍ AI, ແລະ ສົ່ງໄປຫາສະຖາບັນລັດທີ່ເໝາະສົມໂດຍອັດຕະໂນມັດ.
faq.qIdentityProtected: ຂ້ອຍລາຍງານບັນຫາແລ້ວ ອັກສອນຂ້ອຍຈະຖືກປົກປ້ອງບໍ?
faq.aIdentityProtected: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ, ຢ່າງສົມບູນ. LikasLens ໃຊ້ໂໝດເຟືອງເພື່ອລຶບຂໍ້ມູນສ່ວນຕົວທັງໝົດອອກຈາກລາຍງານຂອງທ່ານ. ທ່ານບໍ່ຈຳເປັນຕ້ອງສ້າງບັນຊາດ້ວຍຊີ້.
faq.qHowAiTriage: ລະບົບຈັດລຽນຂໍ້ມູນ AI ເຮັດວຽກແນວໃດ?
faq.aHowAiTriage: ເມື່ອທ່ານສົ່ງຮູບ, AI ຂອງພວກເຮົາວິເຄາະຮູບເພື່ອກຳນົດປະເພດໄພອັນຕະລາຍ, ຈັດຄູ່ກັບກົດໝາຍ, ແລະ ສົ່ງໄປຫາສະຖາບັນລັດທີ່ເໝາະສົມໂດຍອັດຕະໂນມັດ.
faq.qAnonymousReport: ຂ້ອຍສາມາດລາຍງານໂດຍບໍ່ລະບຸຊື່ໄດ້ບໍ?
faq.aAnonymousReport: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ. ໂໝດເຟືອງລຶບຂໍ້ມູນສ່ວນຕົວທັງໝົດອອກຈາກລາຍງານຂອງທ່ານ. ທ່ານບໍ່ຈຳເປັນຕ້ອງສ້າງບັນຊາດ້ວຍຊີ້.
faq.qAfterSubmit: ຫຼັງຈາກຂ້ອຍສົ່ງລາຍງານແລ້ວ ມີຫຍັງເກີດຂຶ້ນ?
faq.aAfterSubmit: ລາຍງານຂອງທ່ານຈະຖືກວິເຄາະທັນທີໂດຍ AI, ຈັດຄູ່ກັບກົດໝາຍ, ແລະ ສົ່ງໄປຫາສະຖາບັນລັດທີ່ເໝາະສົມ. ທ່ານຈະໄດ້ຮັບການແຈ້ງເຕືອນກ່ຽວກັບການອັບເດດสถานະ.
faq.qMobileApp: ມີແອັບມືຖືບໍ?
faq.aMobileApp: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ. LikasLens ມີໃຫ້ບໍລິການທັງ Android (APK) ແລະ iOS. ທ່ານສາມາດຕິດຕັ້ງຈາກໜ້ານີ້.
faq.qReportVerification: ລາຍງານຖືກຢັ້ງຢືນແນວໃດ?
faq.aReportVerification: ລາຍງານທັງໝົດຖືກຢັ້ງຢືນໂດຍ AI ກ່ອນ, ຈາກນັ້ນສົ່ງໄປຫາສະຖາບັນລັດທີ່ເໝາະສົມ. ສະຖານະລາຍງານຈະອັບເດດເມື່ອໄດ້ຮັບການຢັ້ງຢືນ.
faq.qWhoSeesReport: ຜູ້ໃດສາມາດເບິ່ງລາຍງານຂອງຂ້ອຍໄດ້?
faq.aWhoSeesReport: ລາຍງານທັງໝົດຈະປາກົດຢູ່ໃນບັນທຶກສາທາລະນະ. ຖ້າທ່ານໃຊ້ໂໝດເຟືອງ, ອັກສອນຂອງທ່ານຈະບໍ່ຖືກເຊື່ອມຕໍ່ກັບລາຍງານ.

dashboard.privacyModeSwitchDesc: You may switch between modes at any time. Ghost Mode can be toggled per-report. When Ghost Mode is active, the system cannot link the report to your account. This is by design, not a limitation.
dashboard.privacyShareDesc: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. Data is shared only in the following limited circumstances.
dashboard.govAgenciesDesc: Verified reports are forwarded to the relevant environmental enforcement agency. Only the report content and location are shared.
dashboard.ngoPartnersDesc: Aggregated, anonymized data may be shared with accredited environmental organizations for research and advocacy.
dashboard.legalComplianceDesc: We may disclose data if required by Philippine law, court order, or to protect the rights and safety of users.

dashboard.privacyCookiesDesc: LikasLens uses minimal local storage. No third-party tracking cookies.

dashboard.privacyChildrenDesc: LikasLens is designed for users aged 13 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that a child has provided personal data, we will take immediate steps to delete that information.
dashboard.privacyChildrenTeenDesc: For users between 13 and 18, we encourage parental guidance when submitting environmental reports, especially those involving sensitive locations or hazardous conditions.

dashboard.dataRightsDesc: Under the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173), you have the following rights:

dashboard.rightToGhostMode: You can toggle Ghost Mode on a per-report basis for maximum flexibility.
dashboard.rightToCorrection: You may request correction of any inaccurate personal data we hold about you.
dashboard.rightToWithdraw: You have the right to withdraw consent for data processing at any time, subject to legal obligations.
dashboard.rightToComplaint: You may file a complaint with the Philippine National Privacy Commission if you believe your data rights have been violated.

dashboard.privacyModeIntro: LikasLens offers two operating modes with different data behaviors. You choose which mode to use on a per-report basis.
dashboard.evidenceDataStandard: Photos with full EXIF metadata (timestamp, GPS, device info), precise GPS coordinates, and address text. Metadata is preserved for forensic integrity.
dashboard.evidenceDataGhost: Photos with all EXIF data stripped. No GPS coordinates, no device identifiers, no timestamps. Only image pixel data and AI-generated classification are retained.
dashboard.profileDataStandard: Your name, email, avatar, trust score, Eco-Credit balance, and report history are linked to your submissions. This enables public accountability and reward tracking.
dashboard.profileDataGhost: No profile data is attached. Your submission is decoupled from your account entirely. The report exists independently with no traceable link to your identity.
dashboard.aiProcessingDataDesc: Images are processed by our YOLOv8 vision model to classify issue type and severity. AI confidence scores and triage summaries are stored alongside your report. The classification pipeline cannot distinguish between Standard and Ghost Mode reports. Every submission receives the same quality of analysis.
dashboard.deviceAndUsageDataDesc: Both modes collect identical anonymous analytics: screen views, feature usage patterns, and crash reports. This data is never personally identifiable and is used solely to improve platform performance.
dashboard.activeReportsDesc: Retained until the report is resolved and the enforcement cycle is complete, plus a 90-day audit window.
dashboard.accountDataDesc: Retained while your account is active. Upon deletion request, all personal data is purged within 30 days.
dashboard.evidencePhotosDesc: Stored encrypted at rest. You may request deletion of individual photos at any time from your dashboard.
dashboard.analyticsLogsDesc: Anonymous usage data is retained for 12 months to improve platform performance, then permanently deleted.
dashboard.sessionTokenDesc: A secure, httpOnly token to keep you logged in. Expires after 24 hours.
dashboard.themePreferenceDesc: Whether you are using Ghost Mode or the standard civic theme.
dashboard.localeSettingDesc: Your preferred language (English, Filipino, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, or Tamil).
dashboard.offlineCacheDesc: Service worker cache for offline report drafting. No personal data is stored.
dashboard.thirdPartyIntro: We use a limited set of infrastructure providers. Each is bound by data processing agreements.
dashboard.supabaseDesc: Authentication and real-time database. Data is stored in encrypted PostgreSQL in the Southeast Asia region.
dashboard.vercelDesc: Frontend hosting and CDN. No personal data is stored on Vercel servers. All data flows directly to our backend.
dashboard.changesNotify: Notify you via email and in-app notification at least 30 days before the changes take effect.
dashboard.changesDisplay: Display a prominent notice on the platform with a summary of what is changing.
dashboard.changesVersionHistory: Maintain a version history so you can review past versions of this policy.
dashboard.contactPrivacyDesc: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out.

dashboard.serviceDescriptionIntro: LikasLens is a civic technology platform that enables Filipino citizens to report environmental violations and concerns to relevant government agencies. The service includes:
dashboard.serviceItem1: A mobile-optimized reporting interface with photo capture, GPS tagging, and category selection.
dashboard.serviceItem2: An AI classification pipeline (YOLOv8) that categorizes reports and estimates severity.
dashboard.serviceItem3: Routing of verified reports to appropriate Local Government Units (LGUs) and national agencies (DENR, DILG, MMDA, etc.).
dashboard.serviceItem4: A public Civic Ledger that records the resolution chain for transparency and accountability.
dashboard.serviceItem5: A gamified Eco-Credits reward system for active citizen reporters.
dashboard.userObligationsIntro: By using LikasLens, you agree to:
dashboard.obligationTruthfullyDesc: Submit only accurate, first-hand observations. Do not file reports based on rumor, speculation, or third-party claims.
dashboard.obligationSafetyDesc: Do not trespass on private property or enter hazardous areas to capture evidence. Use existing public vantage points or photographs taken from safe distances.
dashboard.obligationLocationDesc: Ensure GPS coordinates reflect the actual location of the reported issue. False locations are considered abuse.
dashboard.obligationMode: Use Standard or Ghost Mode appropriately
dashboard.obligationModeDesc: Choose the mode that matches your intent. Ghost Mode is designed for sensitive reports where personal safety is a concern.
dashboard.obligationLawDesc: All reports must comply with the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173), Anti-Wire Tapping Act (RA 4200), and applicable local ordinances.
dashboard.prohibitedIntro: The following are strictly prohibited and may result in immediate account suspension:
dashboard.prohibited1: Reports containing hate speech, threats, or harassment directed at any individual or group.
dashboard.prohibited2: Photographs that capture private individuals without their consent in sensitive contexts (medical, religious, domestic).
dashboard.prohibited3: Misuse of Ghost Mode to file knowingly false reports, abuse the LGU response system, or evade accountability.
dashboard.prohibited4: Attempts to manipulate Eco-Credits, leaderboard rankings, or verification status through automated means, fake accounts, or coordinated inauthentic behavior.
dashboard.prohibited5: Reverse engineering, scraping, or attempting to extract the AI model, classification logic, or backend infrastructure.
dashboard.prohibited6: Use of LikasLens for any commercial purpose, surveillance operation, or law enforcement activity outside the platform's intended civic scope.
dashboard.terminationIntro: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. Termination may occur with or without prior notice depending on severity. Grounds for termination include:
dashboard.termination1: Repeated submission of false or fraudulent reports (more than 3 confirmed false reports within 90 days).
dashboard.termination2: Use of the platform to harass, dox, or target specific individuals.
dashboard.termination3: Coordinated inauthentic behavior at scale (bot networks, paid report farms).
dashboard.termination4: Conduct that poses safety risks to other users, LGU responders, or platform staff.
dashboard.terminationClosing: You may terminate your own account at any time from the profile settings page. Upon termination, all personal data is purged within 30 days, with the exception of records required for legal or audit purposes.
dashboard.disclaimerIntro: LikasLens is provided as a civic tool, not a professional environmental assessment service. We do not warrant that:
dashboard.disclaimer1: Reports submitted will result in enforcement action by any government agency.
dashboard.disclaimer2: AI classifications are legally admissible as environmental assessments.
dashboard.disclaimer3: The platform will be available without interruption, error-free, or free of security vulnerabilities.
dashboard.disclaimer4: Eco-Credits or rank progression carry any monetary, legal, or regulatory value.
dashboard.disclaimerClosing: LikasLens is a channel for citizen reporting. Final regulatory action remains the responsibility of DENR, LGUs, and other authorized bodies.
dashboard.liabilityIntro: To the maximum extent permitted by Philippine law, LikasLens and its operators shall not be liable for:
dashboard.liability1: Indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the platform.

privacy.privacyPolicyDesc: At LikasLens, environmental protection and data privacy are two sides of the same coin. Here is how we protect your digital footprint.
privacy.standardGpsAttached: GPS coordinates attached to evidence photos
privacy.standardReportVisible: Report visible on your public profile
privacy.ghostExifScrubbed: All EXIF metadata scrubbed from photos
privacy.privacyModeSwitchDesc: You may switch between modes at any time. Ghost Mode can be toggled per-report. When Ghost Mode is active, the system cannot link the report to your account. This is by design, not a limitation.
privacy.privacyShareDesc: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. Data is shared only in the following limited circumstances.
privacy.govAgenciesDesc: Verified reports are forwarded to the relevant environmental enforcement agency. Only the report content and location are shared.
privacy.ngoPartnersDesc: Aggregated, anonymized data may be shared with accredited environmental organizations for research and advocacy.
privacy.legalComplianceDesc: We may disclose data if required by Philippine law, court order, or to protect the rights and safety of users.
privacy.privacyRetentionDesc: We retain your data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes in this policy.
privacy.privacyCookiesDesc: LikasLens uses minimal local storage. No third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.aes256Desc: at rest for all stored evidence and personal data
privacy.rateLimitingDesc: on all API endpoints to prevent abuse and brute-force attacks
privacy.rbacDesc: ensuring only authorized personnel can access report details
privacy.regularSecurityAuditsDesc: and penetration testing by independent assessors
privacy.privacyChildrenDesc: LikasLens is designed for users aged 13 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that a child has provided personal data, we will take immediate steps to delete that information.
privacy.privacyChildrenTeenDesc: For users between 13 and 18, we encourage parental guidance when submitting environmental reports, especially those involving sensitive locations or hazardous conditions.
privacy.yourDataRights: Your Rights Under the Data Privacy Act
privacy.dataRightsDesc: Under the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173), you have the following rights:
privacy.rightToDelete: You have the right to request full deletion of your account and associated history.
privacy.rightToExport: You can export your reporting data at any time for your own records.
privacy.rightToGhostMode: You can toggle Ghost Mode on a per-report basis for maximum flexibility.
privacy.rightToCorrection: You may request correction of any inaccurate personal data we hold about you.
privacy.rightToWithdraw: You have the right to withdraw consent for data processing at any time, subject to legal obligations.
privacy.rightToComplaint: You may file a complaint with the Philippine National Privacy Commission if you believe your data rights have been violated.
privacy.privacyChangesDesc: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. When we make material changes, we will:
